assert split_escaped("a\\,b,,c\\\\d")==["a,b","","c\\d"]

Behavior: Split on unescaped commas. Backslash may escape only comma or backslash. Preserve empty fields. Return the failure value for another escape or a trailing backslash.
Visible example: The input a\,b,,c produces the three fields ["a,b", "", "c"].
